messages.subject: More ggplot2 examples
parts:
Hi everyone,

I've just discovered http://learnr.wordpress.com which is "a humble
attempt to document my journey in reproducing some of the charts found
on the internet, with a special focus on the charts I would need to
create in my daily job using Excel", using ggplot2 graphics. There's
only four posts so far, but there are some lovely worked examples,
showing both how to visualise the data, and how to use the theme
system to tweak the appearance of the plot.

Hadley
